Internal helper: jsave()'s stop for a file with no data frame to save

Source: R/io.R
dot-jst_jsave_no_frame_stop.Rd

jsave("t13.rds") with no juse() default names the file and writes nothing (Session 351); jsave(file = "t13.rds") joins it (Session 367). Since Session 367 (Fix Slate 14) the stop offers both routes, as the analysis functions' stop for the same condition does: the call with a data frame named first, or a default set and the call run again. The data frame named is the one data frame in the workspace (.jst_frame_holding() with no variables to match: jsave() has no variable to look for, so any data frame counts), or MyData when there is none or there are several. Both lines keep the call's other arguments, and file = when the call named the file with it.

Usage

.jst_jsave_no_frame_stop(
  lead,
  file_val,
  mc,
  envir,
  first = "Name the data frame first:",
  second = "Or set a default first, then run the call:"
)

Arguments

lead

Character(1); the stop's first sentence, ending in a newline.

file_val

Character(1); the file name the call gave.

mc

The call, matched (match.call() in jsave()).

envir

The caller's environment, where the data frames are looked for.

first, second

Character(1); the headings of the two routes.

Value

Does not return; stops.

Details

Since Session 368 (Fix Slate 15) jsave() given neither a data frame nor a file, with no default, comes here too, where it reached the resolver's stop and would have been offered jsave(d), which stops again for want of a file: the lines give the example file the other front-door stops give, "mydata.sav", under headings that say the file is to be named as well.
